annotation.title_clean: Projeto de Lei n. 1797/2024 - Estabelece normas gerais para o desenvolvimento, implementação e uso responsável de sistemas de Inteligência Artificial
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 1797/2024 - General rules for the responsible development, implementation and use of Artificial Intelligence systems
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Dep. Dr. Allan Garcês)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian Bill 1797/2024 sets general rules for responsible AI development and use to protect human rights. It bans discriminatory uses, biometric categorisation and manipulative techniques, imposes strict liability on providers, grants rights to contest decisions, empowers the data protection authority (ANPD) to classify risks, and creates a National AI Council.
key_provisions_or_claims: Bans discriminatory AI, biometric categorisation inferring sensitive traits, untargeted facial scraping, and subliminal/manipulative systems
Providers or operators are strictly liable for property or moral damage regardless of system autonomy
Right to contest and request review of AI decisions and to correct data
ANPD empowered to regulate, sanction and classify AI risk levels via amendment to LGPD
Creates interministerial National Council on AI (CNIA) with civil society participation
